newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - M. Stanley cuts Polycom.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - M. Stanley cuts Polycom.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley analyst Neil Danzger cut Polycom Inc to neutral from outperform.
-- The analyst said he cut his 1997 earnings estimate on the company, a maker of audio and data conferencing products, to breakeven from his prior estimate of $0.20.
-- Danzger said he cut his 1998 earnings outlook to $0.27 per share from $0.35.
-- He suspended his former price target of 10 in taking the rating down to neutral.
-- Danzger said that, "(Polycom) reported earnings that were in line with expectations; however we believe that they benefited from a settlement with U.S. Robotics (Corp)."
-- Tuesday, the company reported net income of $0.03 per share for the fourth quarter of 1996 versus $0.01 per share in the 1995 fourth period.
-- The analyst said he believes the company will have to make substantial investments in the coming year in its data conferencing product to make it competitive.
